meta.name: The Stoning of Soraya M
meta.description: In 1986 Iran, Sahebjam, whose car breaks down in a remote village, enters into a conversation with Zahra, who relays to him the story about her niece, Soraya, whose arranged marriage to an abusive tyrant ended in tragedy.
meta.slogan: When a deadly conspiracy became a shameful cover-up One witness refused to be silent
